convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for a custom indicator (AsimmetricStochNR) and depends on external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Opposite stochastic crossover closes existing position (BUY_Close when Stoch crosses below Signal, SELL_Close when Stoch crosses above Signal), gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: negative values = fixed lot size (absolute value), positive values = share of deposit fraction. Default MM=-0.1 means 0.1 lots fixed

custom_logic_notes: Signal detection uses bars at SignalBar (1) and SignalBar+1 (2) via CopyBuffer with 2-element arrays: Stoch[1]>Sign[1] AND Stoch[0]<Sign[0] for buy (crossover from below on previous bar), Stoch[1]<Sign[1] AND Stoch[0]>Sign[0] for sell (crossover from above on previous bar). Entry/exit permission controlled by boolean input gates (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose). Signal timestamps computed from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for position open calls. Recount flag handles CopyBuffer failures with retry on next tick. LoadHistory() call ensures IsNewBar() and SeriesInfoInteger() work correctly.
python_conversion_notes: Custom indicator AsimmetricStochNR must be reimplemented or pre-computed. It is an asymmetric stochastic with noise reduction - not a standard stochastic. The smoothing algorithm (CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) supports multiple methods (SMA, JJMA, VIDIA, AMA) and must be ported. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions which handle the MM conditional logic (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction), SL/TP placement, and deviation control - these must be reimplemented. The entry signal logic compares 2 consecutive bars of Stoch vs Signal line for crossover detection. Signal timestamps are computed but may not be critical for backtesting. SL/TP values are in points - need to verify whether digit adjustment (x10 for 5-digit) is handled inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh or needs explicit handling in Python.
